content.short: Icy tools is an NFT tracking and analytics platform.
content.description: Founded in 2021 by Icy Labs, Icy tools is a NFT tracking and analytics platform designed to help collectors, traders, and developers monitor the NFT market. Users can access up-to-date data on floor prices, trading volume, and sale histories for individual NFTs, and view price and volume charts to understand market trends. For developers, an API provides access to on-chain data, enabling programmatic queries. The service also supports alerts for mint events and for wallets that users choose to follow, helping users stay on top of activity they care about.
